1.text: I came rather late to understanding myself in the cycle of life.
1.lessonText: I came rather late to understanding myself in the cycle of life.
functions: to understanding myself in the cycle of life.

clauses.text: I came rather late to understanding myself in the cycle of life.

notes: come late to + 名词／-ing 表示很晚才接触或理解某事；to 是介词。不能套成“事情发展到不得不……”的 come to doing。

2.text: Until three years ago, I was a boy in relation to my grandfather.
2.lessonText: Until three years ago, I was a boy in relation to my grandfather.

clauses.text: Until three years ago, I was a boy in relation to my grandfather.

notes: until 标明这种身份感持续到三年前。不是说作者实际年龄仍未成年，也不只是在转述祖父的看法。

3.text: He lived to 107 and remained mentally and physically capable until the end of his life.
3.lessonText: He lived to 107 and remained mentally and physically capable until the end of his life.
functions: until the end of his life.

clauses.text: He lived to 107 and remained mentally and physically capable until the end of his life.

notes: 同一 He 支配 lived 和 remained，按第一篇标准归简单句。mentally 和 physically 修饰 capable；to 107 表达到的年龄。

4.text: A generation after the last of his friends died, he could still mow the lawn on a hot summer afternoon, and he insisted on doing so.
4.lessonText: A generation after the last of his friends died, he could still mow the lawn on a hot summer afternoon, and he insisted on doing so.

clauses.text: A generation after the last of his friends died, he could still mow the lawn on a hot summer afternoon,
A generation after the last of his friends died,
and he insisted on doing so.

notes: A generation 是 after 前的时距修饰。after 后有 died 的限定分句。doing so 指修剪草坪；insist on 后用 -ing。
A generation 是 after 时间从句的时间量修饰，连同从句一起展示；could、mow 分开着色，still 保持副词身份。

5.text: I usually wrestled the mower from his grip, but his extraordinary energy I took for granted.
5.lessonText: I usually wrestled the mower from his grip, but his extraordinary energy I took for granted.

clauses.text: I usually wrestled the mower from his grip,
but his extraordinary energy I took for granted.

notes: 第二主句是宾语前置：I took his extraordinary energy for granted。energy 不是主语；不能译出原文没有的“我夺不走他的精力”。
第二主句将宾语 his extraordinary energy 前置，I 仍为主语；不能按词序把 energy 误标成主语。

6.text: I had seen it all my life; he was my roommate.
6.lessonText: I had seen it all my life; he was my roommate.

clauses.text: I had seen it all my life;
he was my roommate.

notes: 分号连接两个独立主句。it 指祖父的精力。过去完成时回望已持续很久的经历。

7.text: At my birth he was 64, middle age to him, and he was not a gentle old soul.
7.lessonText: At my birth he was 64, middle age to him, and he was not a gentle old soul.

clauses.text: At my birth he was 64, middle age to him,
and he was not a gentle old soul.

notes: middle age to him 补充说明“64 岁”意味着什么，没有独立谓语。soul 指人，不是字面“灵魂”。

8.text: He argued with the men in the synagogue, screamed at his fellows in the bakery where he worked until his mid-80s.
8.lessonText: He argued with the men in the synagogue, screamed at his fellows in the bakery where he worked until his mid-80s.

clauses.text: He argued with the men in the synagogue, screamed at his fellows in the bakery where he worked until his mid-80s.
where he worked until his mid-80s.

notes: argued 和 screamed 共用 He，作者省略 and 加快节奏。where 修饰 bakery，不指 synagogue；until his mid-80s 指八十五岁上下，并非精确年龄。
argued 与 screamed 共享 He；where 从句仅修饰 bakery。until his mid-80s 是时间短语，不另建从句。

9.text: He was a lover of strife, even at a distance.
9.lessonText: He was a lover of strife, even at a distance.

clauses.text: He was a lover of strife, even at a distance.

notes: even at a distance 是介词短语；中文可顺译为小句，但不能反过来据译文判定英文有从句。

10.text: For war news he turned up the volume on the television.
10.lessonText: For war news he turned up the volume on the television.

clauses.text: For war news he turned up the volume on the television.

notes: turn up 表调高。for war news 是前置介词短语，并没有 when 引导的限定从句。

11.text: We never had to take care of each other, but as I learned to read, I voluntarily became his teacher.
11.lessonText: We never had to take care of each other, but as I learned to read, I voluntarily became his teacher.

clauses.text: We never had to take care of each other,
but as I learned to read, I voluntarily became his teacher.
as I learned to read,

notes: as 表时间，不是原因。never had to 表从无必要，不是“禁止互相照顾”。
as 明确按 Time clause 处理；never 是否定副词，had to take 是谓语链，care 为名词宾语，of 引出照顾对象。

12.text: My grandfather came to the United States from Lithuania before World War I.
12.lessonText: My grandfather came to the United States from Lithuania before World War I.

clauses.text: My grandfather came to the United States from Lithuania before World War I.

notes: before 后是战争名称，不是从句。to 与 from 分别表示目的地和出发地。

13.text: He went to night school, could read and write English.
13.lessonText: He went to night school, could read and write English.

clauses.text: He went to night school, could read and write English.

notes: 两个谓语共用主语 He，逗号替代常规 and，具有简短叙事节奏。read 与 write 又共享 could 和宾语 English。
went、could read、write 为同一主句的并列谓语；read 与 write 共享 could，and 单独作为连接词。

14.text: Still, I, the emissary of elementary school, considered it my duty to inform him about subtle things like electricity as he got ready for bed after a 12-hour workday.
14.lessonText: Still, I, the emissary of elementary school, considered it my duty to inform him about subtle things like electricity as he got ready for bed after a 12-hour workday.
functions: to inform him about subtle things like electricity

clauses.text: Still, I, the emissary of elementary school, considered it my duty to inform him about subtle things like electricity as he got ready for bed after a 12-hour workday.
as he got ready for bed after a 12-hour workday.

notes: considered it my duty to…：it 是形式宾语，my duty 为宾补，to inform… 是后置的真正宾语。as 引出时间背景。大词 emissary 与小学身份形成自嘲。
it 为形式宾语，my duty 为 Object complement；to inform… 为后置不定式宾语。as 时间从句中的 got 为系动词，ready 为表语。

15.text: He was not too interested in my lectures.
15.lessonText: He was not too interested in my lectures.

clauses.text: He was not too interested in my lectures.

notes: be interested in 为形容词结构。not too 在此是“并不很”，不是“不能过于”。

16.text: Within minutes, he fell into a deep sleep.
16.lessonText: Within minutes, he fell into a deep sleep.

clauses.text: Within minutes, he fell into a deep sleep.

notes: within minutes 表很短时间内。fall into a sleep 描述进入睡眠，不是跌进某个物理空间。

17.text: His characteristic snoring pattern was a muted whistle that ended in a great puff of breath.
17.lessonText: His characteristic snoring pattern was a muted whistle that ended in a great puff of breath.
functions: in a great puff of breath.

clauses.text: His characteristic snoring pattern was a muted whistle that ended in a great puff of breath.
that ended in a great puff of breath.

notes: that 指 whistle／这个鼾声模式，在从句中作主语。snoring 为名词性定语，不能当作另一个谓语。

18.text: But even asleep there was nothing gentle about this man.
18.lessonText: But even asleep there was nothing gentle about this man.

clauses.text: But even asleep there was nothing gentle about this man.
even asleep

notes: gentle 后置修饰不定代词 nothing。even asleep 可理解为 even when he was asleep，本文没有写出限定谓语，按教学分流仍归简单句并提示省略。
even asleep 使用中性的 Reduced concessive clause；when he was 仅在 Ellipsis 中说明，不加入原文或谓语着色。

19.text: He specialized in hating his enemies, even those long dead.
19.lessonText: He specialized in hating his enemies, even those long dead.

clauses.text: He specialized in hating his enemies, even those long dead.

notes: specialize in 后接 -ing。those 指 enemies；long dead 是形容词后置修饰，不是完整定语从句。

20.text: As he talked in his sleep, he exploded in anger.
20.lessonText: As he talked in his sleep, he exploded in anger.

clauses.text: As he talked in his sleep, he exploded in anger.
As he talked in his sleep,

notes: as 表伴随的时间。exploded 为比喻性的情绪爆发，不是身体或物体爆炸。

21.text: From his dreams I learned the curse words of English and Yiddish.
21.lessonText: From his dreams I learned the curse words of English and Yiddish.
functions: the curse words of English and Yiddish.

clauses.text: From his dreams I learned the curse words of English and Yiddish.

notes: and 连接两种语言名。dreams 通过语境指梦中说的话，不是作者直接进入祖父的梦境。

22.text: Cushioned by his puffs of breath, visions of destruction crowded our room.
22.lessonText: Cushioned by his puffs of breath, visions of destruction crowded our room.
functions: Cushioned by his puffs of breath,

clauses.text: Cushioned by his puffs of breath, visions of destruction crowded our room.

notes: Cushioned 的逻辑主语是 visions；过去分词表达被托载或包裹的关系。crowded 是主句谓语。这是意象描写，不是房间真出现灾难。
Cushioned by… 为过去分词附加语，其逻辑主语是 visions of destruction；本句唯一限定谓语为 crowded。

23.text: Boils sprouted on the intestines of his enemies.
23.lessonText: Boils sprouted on the intestines of his enemies.
functions: on the intestines of his enemies.

clauses.text: Boils sprouted on the intestines of his enemies.

notes: Boils 是名词“疖／脓疮”，不是 boil“沸腾”的动词形式。承接梦中诅咒，不当作医学陈述。

clauses.text: Cholera depopulated their villages.

notes: depopulated 为及物动词，地点作宾语。指祖父诅咒中的村庄，不必加强为“所有人都死了”。

25.text: The deep background of his life as it escaped through his lips became the chorus of my nights.
25.lessonText: The deep background of his life as it escaped through his lips became the chorus of my nights.
functions: The deep background of his life

clauses.text: The deep background of his life as it escaped through his lips became the chorus of my nights.
as it escaped through his lips

notes: as 从句说明往事以梦话流露的过程，it 指 background 所代表的过往经历。主语中心 background 对应 became，不是 lips。
as 从句表示往事从嘴边流露的过程，采用 Time clause；外层主语中心 background 与 became 对应。

26.text: I heard him the way you hear static through a radio.
26.lessonText: I heard him the way you hear static through a radio.

clauses.text: I heard him the way you hear static through a radio.
you hear static through a radio.

notes: the way 后的 you hear… 指方式，可理解为 the way (that/in which) you hear…。static 在此为不可数名词“干扰杂音”。
you hear… 是修饰 the way 的省略关系词结构，使用 Relative clause；that / in which 仅在省略提示中出现。

27.text: My young ears didn't want to listen to the uncorked anger, didn't know what to make of feelings that could stretch back 70 years.
27.lessonText: My young ears didn't want to listen to the uncorked anger, didn't know what to make of feelings that could stretch back 70 years.
functions: to listen to the uncorked anger,

clauses.text: My young ears didn't want to listen to the uncorked anger, didn't know what to make of feelings that could stretch back 70 years.
that could stretch back 70 years.

notes: 两个 didn't 谓语共享主语，that 从句修饰 feelings。what to make of 表“不知如何看待／理解”，不是制作；ears 代指年幼的自己。
what to make of… 为疑问不定式补足，不增设有限定谓语的 Object clause；that 定语从句修饰 feelings。

28.text: But now, I recall those staccato outbursts as music.
28.lessonText: But now, I recall those staccato outbursts as music.

clauses.text: But now, I recall those staccato outbursts as music.

notes: recall A as B 将过去声音重新赋予意义。as 后是名词，不是从句；与前句 static 形成情感上的反差。

29.text: When I went to college, I switched to roommates my age.
29.lessonText: When I went to college, I switched to roommates my age.

clauses.text: When I went to college, I switched to roommates my age.
When I went to college,

notes: my age 后置修饰 roommates，相当于 of my age，不是新从句。switch to 后是转向的对象。

30.text: Then, in graduate school, I had my own apartment, and my old roommate joined me.
30.lessonText: Then, in graduate school, I had my own apartment, and my old roommate joined me.

clauses.text: Then, in graduate school, I had my own apartment,
and my old roommate joined me.

notes: old roommate 指祖父，old 同时含年龄大和从前的意味；两个主句用 and 连接。

31.text: All his friends were dead, and he had lived long enough to become, once again, a stranger in the community he had inhabited for more than half a century.
31.lessonText: All his friends were dead, and he had lived long enough to become, once again, a stranger in the community he had inhabited for more than half a century.
functions: for more than half a century.

clauses.text: All his friends were dead,
and he had lived long enough to become, once again, a stranger in the community he had inhabited for more than half a century.
he had inhabited for more than half a century.

notes: enough to… 表达到某程度而出现的结果。定语从句修饰 community，省略的关系词在 inhabited 后作宾语；once again 是插入状语。
to become… 为结果不定式；he had inhabited… 修饰 community，省略关系宾语 that / which。

32.text: It was clear to both of us that in spite of a 60-year age gap I was his most congenial companion.
32.lessonText: It was clear to both of us that in spite of a 60-year age gap I was his most congenial companion.
functions: in spite of a 60-year age gap

clauses.text: It was clear to both of us that in spite of a 60-year age gap I was his most congenial companion.
that in spite of a 60-year age gap I was his most congenial companion.

notes: it 是形式主语，that 从句是后置真正主语。in spite of 后是名词短语，不是让步从句。60-year 作定语时 year 不加 -s。
that… 作后置真正主语，使用中性 Subject clause；in spite of 后接名词短语，不新增让步从句。

33.text: So he joined me in the late 1960s at the University of Michigan.
33.lessonText: So he joined me in the late 1960s at the University of Michigan.

clauses.text: So he joined me in the late 1960s at the University of Michigan.

notes: join 直接接人，不说 join with me 来表达这里的“来与我同住”。late 1960s 指六十年代末期。

34.text: He made new friends, took care of himself, and did most of the housework.
34.lessonText: He made new friends, took care of himself, and did most of the housework.

clauses.text: He made new friends, took care of himself, and did most of the housework.

notes: 三个动作共享主语 He，按同一标准归简单句。housework 不可数。
made、took、did 共享主语；took care of 保留词组点击，限定谓语色只落在 took，care 为名词宾语。

35.text: In Ann Arbor he found plenty of allies in hating Republicans, but it was even better than that.
35.lessonText: In Ann Arbor he found plenty of allies in hating Republicans, but it was even better than that.

clauses.text: In Ann Arbor he found plenty of allies in hating Republicans,
but it was even better than that.

notes: in hating 是介词＋-ing，说明结盟的共同点；than 后的 that 为代词，不是完整比较从句。

36.text: Ideologically it was the best of times.
36.lessonText: Ideologically it was the best of times.

clauses.text: Ideologically it was the best of times.

notes: 句首副词限定评判角度。the best of times 与祖父爱争辩的性格呼应，带幽默意味。

37.text: He could enjoy both the war and the anti-war movement.
37.lessonText: He could enjoy both the war and the anti-war movement.
functions: both the war and the anti-war movement.

clauses.text: He could enjoy both the war and the anti-war movement.

notes: both A and B 连接宾语，不是两个从句。enjoy 指他从争斗与争论中获得兴味，不把字面悖论“修正”掉。

38.text: Our only serious problem was what he called my laziness.
38.lessonText: Our only serious problem was what he called my laziness.

clauses.text: Our only serious problem was what he called my laziness.
what he called my laziness.

notes: what 引导融合关系结构并在 called 后作宾语，my laziness 是宾补；整体作 was 的表语。不是普通疑问句。
what he called my laziness 是融合关系结构，按整句功能标为 Predicative clause；what 作 called 的宾语，my laziness 作 Object complement。

39.text: I was studying for Ph.D. preliminary exams.
39.lessonText: I was studying for Ph.D. preliminary exams.

clauses.text: I was studying for Ph.D. preliminary exams.

notes: for 表备考的对象。Ph.D. 是缩写，其中句点不构成分句边界；继续沿用当前音频。

40.text: My work consisted of lying on the couch with a book in my lap.
40.lessonText: My work consisted of lying on the couch with a book in my lap.
functions: with a book in my lap.

clauses.text: My work consisted of lying on the couch with a book in my lap.

notes: consist of 后接 -ing。with + 名词 + 介词短语描述伴随状态；没有独立限定谓语，不归限定从句。
lying 是 of 后的动名词／分词补足，with a book in my lap 为无谓语伴随结构，不与 consisted 并列着色。

41.text: Sometimes I dozed off, now and then I highlighted a significant passage.
41.lessonText: Sometimes I dozed off, now and then I highlighted a significant passage.

clauses.text: Sometimes I dozed off,
now and then I highlighted a significant passage.

notes: 两完整主句以逗号并置，文学叙述形成交替节奏。正式论说文通常改用分号或 and，避免照抄成一般标点规则。
两个主句用逗号并置，分别保留 dozed off 与 highlighted；now and then 为第二主句时间状语。

42.text: He would pick up a pencil and mockingly mark the newspaper to imitate what I was doing.
42.lessonText: He would pick up a pencil and mockingly mark the newspaper to imitate what I was doing.

clauses.text: He would pick up a pencil and mockingly mark the newspaper to imitate what I was doing.
what I was doing.

notes: would 表过去经常发生的习惯，不是条件句。what 从句作 imitate 的宾语；pick up 与 mark 共享 would。
what I was doing 按 imitate 的宾语功能标为 Object clause；what 为融合关系词。to imitate 本身是目的不定式，would pick up 与 mark 共享 would。

43.text: I could not convince him that it was work.
43.lessonText: I could not convince him that it was work.

clauses.text: I could not convince him that it was work.
that it was work.

notes: convince somebody that… 表说服某人相信某事。it 指读书备考，不是报纸。
that it was work 是 convince 的内容补足，沿用 Object clause 标签；him 为被说服的人。

clauses.text: But I did convince others.

notes: did 强调肯定事实，后接动词原形 convince。与前句 could not 形成转折，指学业得到其他人的认可。

45.text: I finished my studies, married, fathered a daughter and a son and settled in Texas.
45.lessonText: I finished my studies, married, fathered a daughter and a son and settled in Texas.

clauses.text: I finished my studies, married, fathered a daughter and a son and settled in Texas.

notes: 多个限定谓语共用 I，仍按一个主句处理。fathered 是动词“成为……的父亲”，不是名词所有格。

46.text: Though reluctant to move once again, my grandfather joined us in Houston.
46.lessonText: Though reluctant to move once again, my grandfather joined us in Houston.

clauses.text: Though reluctant to move once again, my grandfather joined us in Houston.
Though reluctant to move once again,

notes: though 后可还原 he was reluctant，原文用无动词省略结构；按限定分句口径归简单句，作为省略重点讲。reluctant 后接 to do。
Though reluctant… 使用 Reduced concessive clause，省略 he was 只列于 Ellipsis；to move 是 reluctant 的不定式补足。

47.text: He was exactly 100 years older than my son.
47.lessonText: He was exactly 100 years older than my son.

clauses.text: He was exactly 100 years older than my son.

notes: 100 years 说明比较级差额；此处不是前置复合形容词，所以 years 用复数。与 100-year-old 的写法区分。

48.text: Now that I was established, a man with a career, a family, a job, I intended to help my grandfather in the last years of his life.
48.lessonText: Now that I was established, a man with a career, a family, a job, I intended to help my grandfather in the last years of his life.
functions: a man with a career, a family, a job,
to help my grandfather in the last years of his life.

clauses.text: Now that I was established, a man with a career, a family, a job, I intended to help my grandfather in the last years of his life.
Now that I was established, a man with a career, a family, a job,

notes: a man… 补充说明从句中的 I，不是另一个主语。now that 表既然新条件已具备；intend to do 表打算。
Now that 原因从句范围包含 a man… 同位补充；was established 采用状态性系表分析，established 表示已安定、有事业。

49.text: But in the crazy irony of things, it turned out that I was the one who would need help.
49.lessonText: But in the crazy irony of things, it turned out that I was the one who would need help.
functions: in the crazy irony of things,

clauses.text: But in the crazy irony of things, it turned out that I was the one who would need help.
that I was the one who would need help.
who would need help.

notes: it turned out that… 意为“结果发现……”。who 修饰 the one，指 I。不是 It was…that 强调句框架；反差在于照顾者变成求助者。
it 是形式主语，that… 是后置 Subject clause，并嵌套修饰 the one 的 Relative clause；不是强调句。

50.text: My solid life cracked in a matter of months, when my wife was stricken with a terrible neurologic disease.
50.lessonText: My solid life cracked in a matter of months, when my wife was stricken with a terrible neurologic disease.

clauses.text: My solid life cracked in a matter of months, when my wife was stricken with a terrible neurologic disease.
when my wife was stricken with a terrible neurologic disease.

notes: when 补充悲剧发生的时间背景，语境中也有因果联系；不是 because 的明说。was stricken with 为遭重病侵袭的书面表达。
when 采用补充时间从句分析；was stricken 为被动谓语，with 引出疾病。

51.text: The life of the family became the life of the hospital.
51.lessonText: The life of the family became the life of the hospital.

clauses.text: The life of the family became the life of the hospital.

notes: 两个 life 构成对照；the life of the hospital 是医院化生活的转喻，不是建筑物获得生命。

52.text: I lost touch with my friends, my work, even my children.
52.lessonText: I lost touch with my friends, my work, even my children.
functions: with my friends, my work, even my children.

clauses.text: I lost touch with my friends, my work, even my children.

notes: lose touch with 的 with 后是三个并列名词；even 强调孩子这一项最令人意外。
lost touch with 保留完整生词点击；限定谓语为 lost，touch 为宾语，with 引出失去联系的对象。

53.text: I could not scream out my anger as my grandfather did in his sleep.
53.lessonText: I could not scream out my anger as my grandfather did in his sleep.

clauses.text: I could not scream out my anger as my grandfather did in his sleep.
as my grandfather did in his sleep.

notes: did 替代 scream out his anger，避免重复。as 表方式比较，不是时间“当……”。
as 采用 Comparative clause 表示方式比较，不标 Time clause；did 替代 screamed out his anger，省略只在提示中呈现。

54.text: Instead, I turned it against myself, and it settled in my bones as depression.
54.lessonText: Instead, I turned it against myself, and it settled in my bones as depression.

clauses.text: Instead, I turned it against myself,
and it settled in my bones as depression.

notes: 两处 it 都指 anger。第二句用身体意象表达情绪长期沉积；as 后是名词，不是从句。

55.text: I returned to the couch where I had studied for my Ph.D. exams, but I no longer saw anything glorious to underline.
55.lessonText: I returned to the couch where I had studied for my Ph.D. exams, but I no longer saw anything glorious to underline.

clauses.text: I returned to the couch where I had studied for my Ph.D. exams,
where I had studied for my Ph.D. exams,
but I no longer saw anything glorious to underline.

notes: where 修饰 couch，表示在沙发上读书。glorious 后置修饰 anything；to underline 修饰可供划线的内容，逻辑主语是 I。
Ph.D. 保持缩写完整；where 从句修饰 couch，to underline 为 anything glorious 的不定式修饰。

56.text: At 103 and 104, my grandfather began to take an active role in helping me care for my children.
56.lessonText: At 103 and 104, my grandfather began to take an active role in helping me care for my children.
functions: in helping me care for my children.

clauses.text: At 103 and 104, my grandfather began to take an active role in helping me care for my children.

notes: in 后接 helping；help me care for 中 care 为不带 to 的不定式，help 后两种形式均可。数字间 and 不构成并列句。

57.text: He did not understand what had happened to my wife and had no sympathy for my depression.
57.lessonText: He did not understand what had happened to my wife and had no sympathy for my depression.

clauses.text: He did not understand what had happened to my wife and had no sympathy for my depression.
what had happened to my wife

notes: what 在从句中作主语，happened 无被动。understand 与 had 共用 He；没有明说理解，却有后文实际行动。
what 引导 understand 的嵌入疑问宾语从句并作其主语；and had 在外层与 understand 并列，不能误收进 what 从句。

58.text: But he saw the work of daily life in front of him and, as always, he did it.
58.lessonText: But he saw the work of daily life in front of him and, as always, he did it.

clauses.text: But he saw the work of daily life in front of him
and, as always, he did it.
as always,

notes: 第二主句有明确主语 he。as always 是压缩的评注，意为像往常一样；it 指需要做的日常工作。
as always 为压缩的 Parenthetical comment；没有原文限定谓语，不补造橙色动词。第二主句 he did it 仍保留。

59.text: Although by then he must have been wearing the shadow of death as an undershirt, the aroma of life stayed in his nostrils.
59.lessonText: Although by then he must have been wearing the shadow of death as an undershirt, the aroma of life stayed in his nostrils.

clauses.text: Although by then he must have been wearing the shadow of death as an undershirt, the aroma of life stayed in his nostrils.
Although by then he must have been wearing the shadow of death as an undershirt,

notes: must have been wearing 是对过去持续状态的推测。死亡是汗衫、生命有香气，两个比喻共同写出高龄与活力并存，不能只作字面翻译。
must have been wearing 整体属于 Although 让步从句，使用从句谓语色；外层 stayed 使用主句色。

60.text: He listened to the news, he read the paper, he took out the garbage, he played with my children, he mowed the lawn.
60.lessonText: He listened to the news, he read the paper, he took out the garbage, he played with my children, he mowed the lawn.

clauses.text: He listened to the news,
he read the paper,
he took out the garbage,
he played with my children,
he mowed the lawn.

notes: 每一项都重复 he 并有谓语，构成无连词并置的多个主句。逗号串联是文学节奏，不是正式写作中任意连接主句的许可。
五个主句以逗号并置，各有 he 主语与限定谓语；不是一个主语下五个单纯动词短语。

61.text: He never offered me advice or understanding, he just kept doing things.
61.lessonText: He never offered me advice or understanding, he just kept doing things.

clauses.text: He never offered me advice or understanding,
he just kept doing things.

notes: 两个主句用逗号并置；offered me advice 为双宾语结构。keep doing 表持续，不用 keep to do。
never 单列为否定副词；kept 为第二主句谓语，doing things 为非谓语补足。

62.text: After about two years of melancholy, I joined him, started to see how much there was to do.
62.lessonText: After about two years of melancholy, I joined him, started to see how much there was to do.
functions: After about two years of melancholy,

clauses.text: After about two years of melancholy, I joined him, started to see how much there was to do.
how much there was to do.

notes: started 共用主语 I。how much 引出间接感叹／疑问性内容，much 指工作量；to do 修饰待做之事。
how much there was to do 是 see 的嵌入疑问／感叹宾语内容；how much 是存在结构的前置实义主语，there 为存在标记，was 为从句系动词。

63.text: Now I get up early and I stay busy.
63.lessonText: Now I get up early and I stay busy.

clauses.text: Now I get up early
and I stay busy.

notes: 两边都写出 I，按既定标准归并列句。stay busy 中 stay 为系动词，不是“停留在忙”。

64.text: There's a lot of garbage to take out and in Texas there's always a lawn to mow.
64.lessonText: There's a lot of garbage to take out and in Texas there's always a lawn to mow.

clauses.text: There's a lot of garbage to take out
and in Texas there's always a lawn to mow.

notes: 两个 there be 结构并列。to take out / to mow 的动作由人执行，被修饰名词与动词有宾语关系；不定式用主动形式，意为待处理的事。
两处 there’s 拆成存在标记 there 与系动词 ’s；always 不计入谓语，to take out 与 to mow 为非谓语修饰。

65.text: I don't talk in my sleep yet, but even if I start, nobody will hear me.
65.lessonText: I don't talk in my sleep yet, but even if I start, nobody will hear me.

clauses.text: I don't talk in my sleep yet,
but even if I start, nobody will hear me.
even if I start,

notes: even if 表假设“即使”，不表示已经开始。start 后省略 talking in my sleep；nobody 暗示祖父已不在，照应室友主题。
even if 带让步含义，沿用 Conditional clause 及条件蓝色；start 后省略的 talking in my sleep 仅在提示中注明。

66.text: Roommates like him only come along about one a century.
66.lessonText: Roommates like him only come along about one a century.

clauses.text: Roommates like him only come along about one a century.

notes: like him 修饰 Roommates；about one a century 是压缩的频率说法，近于 at a rate of about one per century。以夸张表达珍爱，并非统计结论。
